description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Pahala Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.420500 (24/0714)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for multiple parcels in Kurunegala District. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, extent measurements, ownership details, and property characteristics, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
